system.description: While equipped with a ballistic shield, allies within 1 tile of you gain -5 D.M. to their ranged attack rolls. This bonus is doubled to -10 D.M. while you are taking the shield wall action.
When taking the Shield Wall action reduce any damage taken by 1/3rd and redirect any attack made against an ally within 1 tile of you to yourself.
Gain +1 bonus critical damage for every two enemies the character can currently see. This effect stacks up to +8.

When an enemy approaches within 4 tiles you may spend a reaction to take a reaction shot against them. If no reactions are available you may spend 4 energy to use this feature.

Costs 4 Energy
While equipped with a ballistic shield you may add a bonus to your dodge checks equal to the number of tiles away the attacker is from times two.
The energy cost of Run and Gun is decreased by 1. Gain a point in the athletics skill. If athletics is maxed then add a point to any other physical skill.
Gain -25 D.M. to dodge checks against any attacks made against you by targets within 4 tiles.

Upon activating Run and Gun the critical damage bonus of any weapon used is increased by 50% (rounded up) for that turn. This bonus is applied after every other critical damage boosting effect is calculated.
Any reaction fire directed at you, like from Overwatch or Close Combat Specialist, takes a +50 D.M. to the attack roll and does not benefit from range bonuses.
Once per round when you successfully dodge an attack while equipped with a ballistic shield you may opt to take no damage instead of half.

When you take the Shield Wall action you may spend four energy to allow one ally to move with you on your turn.

Costs 4 Energy

When making an attack you may opt to make a second one against the same target. Both attacks take a +15 D.M. penalty.

Costs 4 Energy
While equipped with a shield you cannot be knocked down or forcibly moved by physical means. In addition you and allies within 1 tile of you take 50% less damage from explosives.

After dashing you may take an action before ending your turn.

Costs 6 Energy.
Gain -20 D.M. to checks to avoid debilitating effects from things like Flashbangs or Paraphysics. In addition you may spend 2 energy to reroll a single check that has benefitted from Steadfast.
Trench Gunner attacks can deal critical hits and costs 1 Energy less.
You gain a +5 armor bonus for every enemy you can see, up to +20.
You gain bonus damage reduction depending on the equipped armor. One for medium armor and two for heavy armor.

Select a target that is within short range from you. When making a successful attack against them you may opt to deal half damage to the target in order to deal that same amount of damage to every creature within 1 tile of them. This ability can only be used with a shotgun and cannot crit.

Costs 4 Energy
Gain -20 D.M. to critical hit chance against targets within short range.
When you are in cover and not flanked, automatically reduce damage from attacks made through that cover by 1. In addition you gain -10 D.M. to dodge checks against attacks on you made through cover.
Enemies within 4 tiles of you take +15 D.M. to any attack rolls and have their mobility reduced by 2.

When taking the Suppressing Fire action you may opt to improve it to Area Suppression instead. This applies suppression to all enemies within 4 tiles of the target.

Costs 4 Energy.

When taking the Suppressing Fire action you may opt to improve it to Area Suppression instead. This applies suppression to all enemies within 4 tiles of the target.

Costs 4 Energy.
Rockets can now critically hit. Rockets always have a critical damage bonus of +2.
Your rockets always impose 2 extra failures (total of three) to cover and structures.
Creatures damaged by your rockets must make a toughness check with a +10 D.M. or become disorientated.
The effect of Area Suppression is increased to a 5 tile radius. Energy cost of Area Suppression is reduced by 1.
Suppressing Fire and Area Suppression consumes 1 less ammo and the first time an enemy triggers a reaction shot from your Suppression it does not consume ammo.
If your rocket scatters from your target destination you reduce the distance scattered by two tiles, to a minimum of one. Stacks with One in the Pipe.

Force an enemy to run to new cover. This attack gains a +30 bonus to hit, but deals 50% less damage, cannot crit, and consumes two additional ammo. Hunkered units cannot be forced to move.

Costs 4 Energy.

The first rocket you take on a mission does not count against your carrying capacity. In addition firing a rocket can be made a non-turn ending action for an energy cost.

Costs 4 Energy.
Your rocket launcher’s range increases by 6 tiles. Rocket Launchers now benefit from targeting.
If a suppressed enemy triggers Reaction Fire from the Suppressing soldier, that attack gains a -20 D.M. bonus.
Any creature suppressed by you takes 3 damage, not reduced by armor, when the effect is applied.
If your rocket scatters from your target destination you reduce the distance scattered by one tile to a minimum of one.

A viscous hail of fire makes the target more vulnerable to subsequent attack. This attack inflicts Rupture (3) on the target on hit. Lasts until the start of appliers next turn.

Costs 4 Energy
Your LMGs now shred armor when they hit the enemy. This is 1/2/3 depending on the tech level of your weapon.
When an enemy is suppressed by you they must make a +30 D.M. Charisma check. If they fail they will panic and be forced to take the Hunker Down action on their turn.

When taking the Shoot Weapon action you can choose to make it not a turn ending action.

Costs 2 Energy.
Upon killing an enemy with your weapon you gain 1 ablative hit point. Stacks up to your Toughness modifier.
Gain -5 D.M. crit chance for every enemy you can see, up to -30 D.M.

When an enemy you can see successfully makes an attack against your allies you may spend a reaction to take a reaction shot against them. If no reactions are available you may spend 3 energy to use this feature.

Costs 3 energy.
Damage dealt with Rifles is increased by 1. Enemies take a +20 D.M. to dodge checks made to mitigate damage from your Rifle.

Your Overwatch reaction fire now also triggers on enemy attacks. Enemies that become the target of your reaction fire are considered in one tier lower cover and they take a +10 D.M. penalty to their attack whether your overwatch hits them or not.
When you are on Overwatch or using the Suppressing Fire action any attack against you takes a +20 D.M. penalty to the attack roll.

When an ally is attacked with a ranged weapon you may use your reaction to spend 1 ammo and draw the enemy’s attention towards yourself, becoming the target of the attack instead.

Costs 5 energy.
Any enemy that is hit by your Reaction fire takes +20 D.M. to the dodge check to reduce damage.
Gain an additional -10 D.M. to dodge from cover and increase and enemy critical hit D.M. by +20 when attacked through cover.
Gain -15 D.M. to attack rolls and Crit Chance when attacking an enemy with less than 50% of its HP.
The Shoot Weapon action is no longer turn ending.
Gain -10 D.M. and Crit Chance when making successive attacks with your rifle against the same target. Does not stack.

Whenever your Overwatch fire is triggered you may opt to spend 2 energy and not take the shot. In addition your first Overwatch shot per round does not consume ammo.

Costs 2 energy.
You no longer take the +15 D.M. penalty to reaction fire and your reaction fire can inflict Critical Hits.

Unleash a hail of fire that is guaranteed to hit your target, but requires 3 units of ammo and both action points.

Costs 4 Energy.

When making an attack you may opt to make a second one against the same target. Both attacks take a +15 D.M. penalty.

Costs 4 energy.
When on Overwatch you have two reaction shots instead of one.
Allies within 6 tiles gain +5 Defense and -10 D.M. bonus to dodge checks as long as you do not move.
Once per Round upon killing an enemy with your rifle refund an action point.

You gain -10 D.M. Critical Hit bonus against creatures you are flanking and an additional -10 D.M. Critical Hit bonus against creatures who have not taken their first turn in combat. Furthermore you cannot roll below a 5 on initiative.
Add -10 D.M. to attacks and +10 Defense against targets at a lower elevation than you.

Whenever you make a ranged attack you may designate it as a Deadeye shot, imposing a +20 D.M. to the attack, but granting +50% damage done if it succeeds.

Costs 3 Energy.

After attacking an enemy you are flanking you may move half your speed.

Costs 4 Energy.
You gain +1 Damage, +1 Pierce to pistols and SMGs. Apply Targeting (1) to a creature that you hit with a ranged weapon attack.

When you kill an enemy with your Sniper Rifle you may make a second attack with a +20 D.M. on the shot. Triggers once per turn. The attack penalty can be removed for 3 Energy.

Costs 3 Energy
Knives gain +2 critical damage when used in Melee. In addition, killing an enemy with a knife does not trigger effects that occur on the death of the target like Sustain.

Take your time to set up the perfect shot. Forfeit an attack on your turn to attack with -20 D.M. when a creature you designate moves. Targets benefit from the cover they had before moving for this attack. This attack is not considered Reaction fire.

Costs 4 Energy.
Gain -10 D.M. to Accuracy and Critical Hit Chance as well as +15 Defense when no allied character is within 6 tiles of you.

Move to an enemy within 1 AP movement range and immediately make an attack with your knife. Not Turn Ending.

Costs 3 energy.
When you use Hit and Run you may move your normal speed instead of half. In addition Hit and Run’s Energy cost is reduced by 1.
You gain a -5 D.M. to Accuracy and Critical Hit chance for each reaction shot avoided with Lightning Reflexes. Lasts until the end of your turn.
Unit gains concealment at start of battle. When making a knife attack against an enemy unaware of your position gain -15 D.M. to the accuracy and -15 D.M. Crit chance.

You gain a -20 D.M. dodge bonus to reduce damage taken from explosives or traps. In addition you gain a point in the awareness skill. If awareness is maxed then add a point to any other physical skill.
Upon killing an enemy in melee you may automatically make a stealth check to hide as long as you are not flanked.
The penalties from the Long Range for Sniper Rifles are reduced by half. You can also fire from Extreme Range.
You gain +1 Damage, +1 Pierce to pistols and SMGs. Apply Targeting (1) to a creature that you hit with a ranged weapon attack.
If you did not move on your last turn gain -10 D.M. to Accuracy Critical Hit chance as long as you hold your current position.
Silent Takedown now automatically grants Concealment. Enemies that can see the target you killed must make a +20 Charisma check or become panicked.
Melee attacks with knives gain -15 D.M. critical hit chance and increases pierce by an additional 2 points.
Whenever you use the help action or a medikit on another character they may attempt a check against any negative mental statuses affecting them with a bonus equal to half your Charisma.
Grenades you use now critically hit for +2 damage. Flashbangs or other offensive support grenades impart +20 D.M. to the check enemies make to resist the effect if the grenade crits.
Flashbangs you deploy can also affect robotic units.

The range you can deploy grenades is increased by 50% and deploying grenades can be made not turn ending for 3 Energy.

Cost 3 Energy.
Any cover or structural damage your explosives inflict is doubled.
Allies affected by your smoke grenades or medikits gain -20 D.M. to Charisma checks and -20 D.M. critical hit chance until the end of your next turn.
Smoke Grenades you deploy have their defense bonus doubled.
Every medikit you carry gains two additional charges for free.

Any enemy that is hit by your Overwatch Reaction fire takes +20 D.M. to the dodge check to reduce damage. In addition you may spend 3 energy to grant a -20 D.M. to any reaction shot you take.

Costs 3 Energy.
The shredding value of your explosives is increased by 1 and deals bonus damage equal to the amount of shred done with that attack.

Move to an ally within 1 action movement range and immediately use a medikit. Not turn ending.

Costs 3 Energy.
Whenever you are on Overwatch, gain an additional reaction shot for every reaction shot that hits, up to 3 reaction shots total.
If the soldier only fires their weapon they may automatically enter Overwatch.
Any damage dealing explosives you use has their damage improved by 1 and any cover damage they may inflict is increased by 1 FP.
All healing you do is increased by 25% of their max HP and anyone healed by you or affected by your smoke grenades gains Morale equal to your Intelligence modifier.
Damaging grenades you use force the enemy to make a +20 D.M. toughness check or Bleed.

Smoke grenades now last an additional turn. For 3 energy you can use a smoke grenade as a non turn ending action.

Costs 3 Energy.
Your medikits can now cure physical debilitations. In addition, using a medikit grants -20 D.M. to the soldier’s next check to resist being afflicted with a physical debilitation.

On kill you may spend 2 energy to make another melee attack against an enemy within your reach.

Costs 2 Energy.
As a reaction you can change the declared facing of your shield wall and shift to protect anyone behind you.

When an enemy enters, attacks from, or leaves your melee range tiles you may spend a reaction to take a reaction attack against them with an actively equipped melee weapon. If no reactions are available you may spend 3 energy to use this feature.

Costs 3 Energy.
When Cleaving with a two handed weapon you roll your weapon die in addition to your normal cleave damage.

Move to an enemy within Sprinting distance and immediately make a melee attack. 

Costs 4 Energy.
Creatures you kill in melee do not trigger any effects that would normally occur on the creature’s death.
When Cleaving with a two handed weapon you deal your full strength bonus to an enemy adjacent to the target of your attack.

While you are engaged in melee the D.M. for shooting you is increased by +10. Enemies normally immune to the Engaged in Melee circumstance still take the penalty when firing at you, but not take the additional +10 D.M.

Two handed Weapons gain -10 D.M to critical hit checks. Any creature you critically hit in melee must make a +10 D.M. toughness check or be disorientated. Creatures already disorientated are instead stunned until the end of their next turn.

Attacks you make when using your Charge ability gain a -20 D.M to the attack. In addition if you are charging with a one handed weapon the charge deals an additional weapon die of damage. Two handed weapons take both die instead of dropping the lowest.
You gain bonus damage reduction depending on the equipped armor. One for medium armor and two for heavy armor. In addition the first three points of Armor Shred you take are ignored.
Gain -25 D.M. to dodge checks against any attacks made against you by targets within 4 tiles. Enemies within 4 tiles of you take +25 D.M. to critical hit tests against you.
Two handed Weapons gain -10 D.M to critical hit checks and +1 critical damage.
Gain -30 D.M. to any check to avoid debilitating effects. In addition you may spend 1 energy to reroll a single check that has benefitted from Indomitable.
All melee weapons you have equipped gain a +10 accuracy bonus. In addition your reaction attacks no longer count as Reaction Fire and can be taken even if the target disengages.

While equipped with a ballistic shield you may add a bonus to your dodge checks equal to the number of tiles away the attacker is from times two. This bonus is doubled while you are taking the Shield Wall action.

The creature takes a deep breath in and exhales a gout of hot fire. Any creature within a 3-tile cone must make a Agility test. Upon success that creature takes half the damage done by the flame breath and no other effects. Upon fail the creature takes the full rolled damage as well as gain the Ignited (2) status.

Cost: 8 Energy

When making a claw attack after moving at least 1 tile, it may add an additional amount of damage to that attack (if successful) equal to 1d4 points of damage. 

Costs: 4 Energy

Pre-Requisites: None

You can dual wield two one handed weapons with a +20 D.M. penalty

Pre-Requisites: Ambidexterity (1)

You can dual wield two one handed weapons with a +10 D.M. penalty

Pre-Requisites: Ambidexterity (2)

You can dual wield two one handed weapons with no penalty

Pre-Requisites: Athletics Rank 2

When using both your action points to Sprint gain +2 tiles of movement as a bonus.

Pre-Requisites: Perception -or- Strength 45

You gain -10 D.M. to attack accuracy, -10 D.M. critical hit chance, and 1 armor piercing against any enemy that cannot take cover like Devourers, Mechs or Tyranyxxians.

Pre-Requisites: Shake it Off, Toughness 60

Hunkering down automatically ends any ongoing effects like Fire or Poison. In addition you may spend 2 energy to heal a number of HP equal to half your toughness bonus when hunkering down.

Pre-Requisites: Agility 45

When you take falling damage you automatically reduce damage taken by a number equal to your agility bonus. In addition gain a+3 bonus to athletics checks used to reduce the damage taken from falling

Pre-Requisites: None

Using the Holotargeter item is no longer considered a turn ending action. In addition you can choose to make it a free action for 3 Energy.

Pre-Requisites: None

Gain +2 HP

Pre-Requisites: Resilience (1), Toughness 45

Gain an additional +2 HP for a total bonus of +4.

Pre-Requisites: Resilience (2), Toughness 55

Gain an additional +2 HP for a total bonus of +6.

Pre-Requisites: Toughness 50

When you take falling damage you automatically reduce damage taken by a number equal to your agility bonus. In addition gain a+3 bonus to athletics checks used to reduce the damage taken from falling

Pre-Requisites: Perception 60

You ignore the penalty for firing at enemies that are engaged in melee.

Pre-Requisites: Strength 50

Your Strength Bonus counts as +2 higher for the purposes of throwing items.

Pre-Requisites: None

Your carry weight is increased by 5.

Pre-Requisites: Strong Back (1)

Your carry weight is increased by an additional 5 for a total of +10.

Pre-Requisites: Strong Back (2)

Your carry weight is increased by an additional 5 for a total of +15.

Pre-Requisites: None

Gain +2 Energy

Pre-Requisites: Tireless (1), Intelligence 45

Gain an additional +2 Energy for a total bonus of +4.

Pre-Requisites: Tireless (2), Intelligence 55

Gain an additional +2 Energy for a total bonus of +6.
Your stratatgems are no longer turn ending actions.
The area of your stratagem zones is increased by 1 tile in both directions. They also last one additional round.

Reduce the cost of all strategem zones by 1 energy, furthermore if a logistical call in takes longer than 1 round to come in reduce that time by 1 turn. You can do this time reduction once per mission.
Increase the amount of XP gained from a successful mission by 10%.

Select an ally within 6 tiles of you, use this ability to grant them a chance to make any single action outside of their turn. This can be an ability or paraphysical resonance. This is not turn ending for you.

Dictate an area that is 5 tiles wide and 3 tiles long, all allies within this zone gain -10 DM to melee and short ranged attacks. They also gain a -5 DM to dodge against melee attacks. They must be in this zone to benefit from the bonuses. This zone lasts for 2 rounds. Turn Ending.
Reduce the cost of all logistics abilites by 10% when they are called in by you.

The effects of your stratagems are now improved as follows:

Forward Operations: Dictate an area that is 5 tiles wide and 3 tiles long, all allies within this zone gain -15 DM to melee and short ranged attacks. They also gain a -10 DM to dodge against melee attacks. They must be in this zone to benefit from the bonuses. This zone lasts for 2 rounds.

Rear Lines: Dictate an area that is 4 tiles wide and 2 tiles long, all allies within this zone gain -15 DM to medium and long ranged attacks. They also gain a +10 defense against ranged attacks. They must be in this zone to benefit from the bonuses. This zone lasts for 2 rounds.
Utilize this ability when you and one other ally are flanking an enemy. Both you and them may make a standard attack against this enemy. These attacks cannot crit. Turn ending.
When an allied creature uses any item or ability that can destroy cover you may use this to double its damage against any cover that the ability or item hits.

Dictate an area that is 4 tiles wide and 2 tiles long, all allies within this zone gain -10 DM to medium and long ranged attacks. They also gain a +5 defense against ranged attacks. They must be in this zone to benefit from the bonuses. This zone lasts for 2 rounds. Turn Ending

You gain a point in tactics, if you already have maximum ranks in it you may allocate the point to any other knowledge skill. At any point in a combat mission you may ask the GM about a specific tactic or ability that an enemy has. You may do this once per mission. The GM must answer this truthfully.
When you use Clear the Room, you can now make an attack against up to 3 foes following its rules, so long as you have the ammo and 10 energy.
Damage dealt with Rifles is increased by 1. Enemies take a +20 D.M. to dodge checks made to mitigate damage from your Rifle.

When you need to enter into a room that is shrouded by fog of war, or otherwise holds unknown enemy locations you can use this ability to gain a -15 DM against any single target in the room. If there are no targets in the room refund the energy cost of this ability.

When you have an ally stacked up outside of a room with you and you use Clear the Room, they can use up to half of their movement to enter the room as well. This is a free action, however, it only benefits one ally and they cannot do any other actions with this special movement bonus.
For every foe within visual range you gain a -1 DM to any attacks you make. This stacks up to -10 DM.
Reduce the cost of all logistics abilites by 10% when they are called in by you.
Upon hitting an enemy target, they do not benefit from any DR on the next attack made against them.
Twice per mission you can reload your weapon as a free action.
When you kill an enemy, this ability automatically extracts the corpse.
For every foe within visual range your allies gain a -1 DM to any attacks they make. This stacks up to -10 DM.
Anytime you hit or miss a target, you and all allies gain a -5 DM to hit that enemy until the start of your next turn. This effect can stack up to two times on a target despite the sources.
As long as you have an ally stacked up outside of a room with you, you gain a -15 DM to any dodge checks against reaction fire against you.
All weapons now gain +1 damage as well as +1 Crit damage.
All damage done by non standard ammo is increased by +2.

After making an attack against one enemy, you may use this to make an additional attack on a different creature within your visual range. This additional attack is made with a +10 DM and cannot crit but will otherwise do standard damage. Costs one ammo per enemy fired upon.

Your Overwatch reaction fire now also triggers on enemy attacks. Enemies that become the target of your reaction fire are considered in one tier lower cover and they take a +10 D.M. penalty to their attack whether your overwatch hits them or not.
You can re-roll any weapon damage done, however, you must take the new damage rolled. This can only be done once per attack.
Any enemy that is hit by your attacks take +15 D.M. to the dodge check to reduce damage.
Gain -10 D.M. to attack rolls and Crit Chance when attacking an enemy with less than 25% of its HP.
When you have used all enhancement slots in a set of medium armor, you gain +1 DR per slot against Ballistic, Physcial, Laser and Plasma damage. This DR is shreddable.

Pour it On!: After using this ability, you gain an additonal +1 Defense equal to all allies within 10 tiles of you.

Rally: All allies now benefit from an additonal +5 defense during the duration of the rally buff.

Chained Shot: For each kill this ability gets, you heal for +1 HP.
Increase your HP and Energy by +2
Increase your HP and Energy by +2
Increase your HP and Energy by +2
Increase your HP and Energy by +3

Pour it On!: When you use this ability, it now will grant you a -10 DM to hit the target the next time you fire on them normally. Furthermore it costs one less Ammo.

Rally: All rallied creatures may have any abilities and Resonances benefit from the Rally buff.

Chained Shot:Your second shot is now made with a +0 DM and can crit.
Medium armor now gains an additonal 50% Ablative armor rounded up that is calculated off the base value of the worn armor.
The total capacity cost of medium armor is reduced by 50%. All medium armor now gains an additional enhancement slot when equipped.

Pour it On!: For each enemy hit by this ability, you gain a stacking -10 DM bonus to your next standard attack after using it.

Rally: For each ally within the rally zone, you personally gain a cumulative -5 DM to your next attack. This ability also costs one less energy to use.

Chained Shot: Chained Shot may now also target the same enemy twice if no other valid targets exist, with the second hit against the same target treating their cover as one tier lower. (Full to half, half to none).
Unleash a hail of fire that is guaranteed to hit your target, but requires 3 units of ammo and both action points.

In an area of tiles equal to your perception modifier rally all allied creatures in that zone. They all gain a -10 DM to any standard attacks made. This lasts until the end of your next turn. Turn Ending.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 3 SAWs and Rifles. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Medium range by -4. Increase their crit damage by +1.

Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 SAWs and Rifles. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by and additional -3. Increase their crit damage by +1.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 3 SMGs and Shotguns. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short range by -4. Increase their crit damage by +1.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 SMGs and Shotguns. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short range by an additional -5. Increase their crit damage by +1.

Pour it On!: All enemies hit with this ability now gain -5 defense against any attack on them until the start of your next turn. Furthermore the energy cost is reduced by one and the ammo cost is reduced to one.

Rally: The rally buff now lasts for 2 full rounds and the DM bonus increases from -10 to -15.

Chained Shot: The second shot is now made at -10 DM instead of 0, and the chain may extend to a third target at +0 DM. This also costs one less energy to use.

Pour it On!: Every enemy hit is forced into a suppressed state. Suppressed enemies that attempt to move or attack on their next turn do so with an additional +10 DM on top of any existing suppression.

Rally: Rallied allies now also gain a free overwatch reaction shot when an enemy moves within their sight range during the rally duration.

Chained Shot: Each successful hit from Chained Shot applies a +10 DM penalty to the hit target's next action, regardless of whether they were the first or last in the chain.

Pour it On!: This ability no longer requires both actions and is not turn ending.

Rally: All allies with this buff now receive a -10 DM to any critical hit chances.

Chained Shot: This ability can be extended to a third creature, the attack against the third creature is done with a +10 DM to the shot and cannot crit.
If you are brought down into negative HP by no more than -10 HP, instead that damage is reduced enough to bring you down to just 0 HP. This works ONCE per mission.
You no longer take the +15 D.M. penalty to reaction fire and your reaction fire can inflict Critical Hits.
If your reaction fire or Punisher abilities kill a foe, they are unable to benefit from any abilities or perks that might otherwise prevent them from dying.
You won't get away with it may now be used against enemies that have thrown or launched explosives.
Any critical damage done with an overwatch or out of turn attack is increased by +3.
When you hit a foe with Interdiction, their movement is now stopped immediately - or when you are able to see them.

While not using your reactions, you can fire upon a melee foe that is targetting an allied creature, if you hit them their movement is stopped within 3 tiles of their target. This attack is considered a standard attack for modifiers. This attack is unable to crit.
Any damage done with an overwatch or out of turn attack is increased by +1.
Whenever your Overwatch fire is triggered you may opt to spend 3 energy and not take the shot. In addition your first Overwatch shot per round does not consume ammo.
When on Overwatch you have two reaction shots instead of one.

You won't get away with it can now inflict its damage on a foe before their shot is made. When a GM calls they are going to make a ranged attack you may inform them you wish to make your shot first with this ability.
You Won't get away with it may now benefit from critical hits.

name: You won't get away with it!

system.description: While not using your reaction, you can fire back against a foe that has damaged an allied creature with a standard attack. This attack is considered a standard attack for modifiers. This attack is unable to crit.

When you opt for this, deal damage to yourself equal to your STR mod. Select any foe that you can see, until they die you gain a -30 DM to hit them as well as crit. If they die from your first attack you regain twice the amount of HP this ability cost.
When using a one handed axe, you gain a -10 D.M. to critical chance and increase its pierce by +2.

Make a vicious attack with either a shotgun, SMG or Axe. This attack gains a -15 DM to hit and a -25 DM to critical chance. If this attack criticals it deals an additional +5 Crit damage. The next attack against you gains a -15 DM to hit and critical chance.
When using either a SMG or a Shotgun, you gain one additional mod slot to them.
When using a two handed axe, you increase its shred by +1.
Base RUN and SPRINT movement speed is increased by 1.
Axes gain an additional modification slot.
For each tile you have moved in this turn, gain a third of that amount as bonus critical damage.
For an additional cost of energy, you can now use Furious Assault against two additional targets if they are within range of your attacks.
For every kill that you gain on a mission, gain an additional 5 credit/valuables at the end of the mission.
For each missing point of HP you have, gain that amount as a bonus - DM to any one check per turn.
One handed axes now gain the ability to be thrown. Two handed axes gain an additional -10 D.M. to critical chance.
While equipped with a ballistic shield, allies within 1 tile of you gain -5 D.M. to their ranged attack rolls. This bonus is doubled to -10 D.M. while you are taking the shield wall action.
When taking the Shield Wall action reduce any damage taken by 1/4th and redirect any attack made against an ally within 1 tile of you to yourself.
While equipped with a ballistic shield you may add a bonus to your dodge checks equal to the number of tiles away the attacker is from times two.
Increase the Ablative HP granted by your shield by 5. Assuming a Shield wall is no longer a full action.
While you are defending an ally, you gain an additional -10 DM to any offensive actions, furthermore, assuming a Shield wall is no longer a full action.
When you take the Shield Wall action you may spend four energy to allow one ally to move with you on your turn.
While equipped with a shield you and ally next to you cannot be knocked down or forcibly moved by physical means. In addition you and allies within 1 tile of you take 50% less damage from explosives.

When you are in a Shield Wall, you can make a free reaction with a pistol or sawn off shotgun to any target that fires at you or anyone within one tile of you. This attack does not suffer from Overwatch modifiers.
Increase the DR of your shield by 2 against Ballistic, Physical, Laser and Plasma.
When you are in a Shield Wall stance, you now count as full cover for both yourself and any ally behind you.
When you are in a Shield Wall and a creature makes an attack against someone you are covering, add your Shields DR to your ally and apply it against any damage type.
Add your shields DR as a bonus to any damage you deal. This does not apply to any Damage over Time.

Your fuel tank can no longer be destroyed when you are wearing the chemthrower. Furthermore increase the fuel amount by 50.

Increase the status effect of your chemthrower by an additional degree (1).
When you use more than one burn worth of fuel you may re-roll the lowest roll damage value and pick the higher.
When using either a fire or cryo based chem thrower, automatically bypass 3 DR against that damage type. Also increase the difficulty of the checks to resist Ignited and Frostbite by +10 D.M.

Using a controlled burst for 30 fuel and some energy blast creatures in a 6 tile line from you. They gain +10 D.M. on top of any checks and allied creatures gain a -25 D.M. to succeed against any checks imposed due to this attack.
For the cost of 25 fuel and some energy use your chemthrower against all creatures in a AoE cone of 3 tiles.

Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 Axes. Furthermore increase the hone of these weapons by -5 and their base damage by 1.

Run and Gun: For each enemy you pass within 2 tiles of during your dash, gain a stacking +1 damage bonus foreach foe that lasts until the end of your turn.

Raid Time: The additional damage you take is reduced to 10%, but whenever you take damage while active, your next attack deals bonus damage equal to the damage taken.

Trench Warfare:  This ability may now be used twice per turn, but the second use must target a different primary target.

Run and Gun: Kills made with the action granted by this ability reset its energy cost for its next use to 0.

Raid Time: Each kill while this is increases the damage on your next attack by +3, this stacks up to +12 damage per round. When you fail to kill an enemy or your Raid Time ends this is reset to 0.

Trench Warfare:  If the primary target is killed by this ability, the full damage (rather than half) is dealt to all creatures within range.
Gain +1 bonus critical damage for every two enemies the character can currently see. This effect stacks up to +8.

Attack with a specialized attack that hits the enemy with a concussive blast. This blast forces them to make a +10 DM Strength save. If they fail they are knocked back 3 tiles and fall prone. Works with shotguns, SMGs and axes.

Run and Gun: After using this ability, you gain defense equal to the amount of spaces you moved.

Raid Time: This ability now only makes you take 20% additional damage from primary weapon sources.

Trench Warfare:  Any critical damage you do now spreads to other foes that are hit with this ability.

Run and Gun: If you kill an enemy after using this ability, you heal for half your TGH modifier.

Raid Time: This ability now lasts for 3 rounds.

Trench Warfare:  The AoE of this ability is extended to 2 tiles instead of 1.
Gain -10 D.M. to dodge checks against any attacks made against you by targets within 4 tiles.

Run and Gun: Upon activating Run and Gun the critical damage bonus of any weapon used is increased by 50% (rounded up) for that turn. This bonus is applied after every other critical damage boosting effect is calculated.

Raid Time: You now gain an additional -10 DM to critical chances against enemies that you hit.

Trench Warfare: This ability can now critically hit your main target, this damage does not extend to the additional targets you hit.
Increase your HP and Energy by +3
Increase your HP and Energy by +2
Increase your HP and Energy by +2
Increase your HP and Energy by +2

You enter a special state called Raid Time. While in this state you deal an additional 25% damage from all primary weapon sources, but you also take an additional 25% damage from all primary weapon sources.  This state lasts for 2 rounds.
After sprinting you may take an action before ending your turn.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 3 Shotguns. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by -3.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 Shotguns. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by -5.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 3 SMGs. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by -3.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 SMGs. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by -5.
You gain a +2 armor bonus for every enemy you can see, up to +20.

Select a target that is within short range from you. When making a successful attack against them you may opt to deal half damage to the target in order to deal that same amount of damage to every creature within 1 tile of them. This ability can only be used with a shotgun, two handed axe or SMG and cannot crit.
Gain -10 D.M. to critical hit chance against targets within short range.
When you are in cover and not flanked, automatically reduce damage from attacks made through that cover by 1. In addition you gain -5 D.M. to dodge checks against attacks on you made through cover.
Enemies within 4 tiles of you take +10 D.M. to any attack rolls and have their mobility reduced by 2.
When using the disengage option it is now considered a free action up to number of times equal to half your AGI mod. (per Mission)
For every successful kill you've made on a mission gain a stacking -5 D.M. to your Critical Hit chance up to half of your AGI mod. This count resets if your are incapacitated or combat ends.

Make a special attack against a target, this attack is made with a -15 D.M. to hit as well as to Crit. If this attacks manages to crit the target automatically gains Vulnerable(15) This attack is turn ending.
As long as you are wearing Light Armor all dodge checks are made with a -5/10/15 D.M. depending on the tier of armor.
Move to an enemy within 1 AP movement range and immediately make an attack with your knife. Not Turn Ending.
When combat begins, you are automatcally concealed. The first attack you make while concealed gains a -10 D.M. to both accuracy crit.
Your concealment bonus to attacks is now increased by an additional -10 D.M. additionally you gain an additional -10 D.M. to any checks agianst AoE effects.
When throwing knives you can now make an additional attack by throwing with normal modifiers to the attack but add an additional 3 Penetration when hitting.
When you successfully kill an enemy while in concealment, it no longer breaks your concealment to have made that attack.
You now recieve a -10 D.M. to any saving throw against abilities or attacks that cause status ailments which do damage.
Attacks with knives gain -5 D.M. critical hit chance and increases penetration by an additional 2 points.
Knives gain +2 critical damage when used in Melee.
Gain +1 Penetration and a -5 to dodge checks for every allied character within 6 tiles of you. Caps at 5 allies.
When you hit a target, if they are behind half cover they gain no benefit to their dodge and if they are behind full cover it only counts as half cover for dodge.
On a number of creatures up to 6 you may fire a shot against them. These attacks are done with a -10 D.M. to hit, however they are unable to critically hit. This is a turn ending action.
You gain +2 Damage, +2 Pierce to pistols and Magnums. Apply Targeting (1) to a creature that you hit with a ranged weapon attack

Whenever you hit and kill an enemy with your Magnum, pick one target that you can see and force them to make a +20 D.M. charisma save. Upon failing they hunker down for their next turn. You can do this a number of times equal to half your CHA Modifier.

At the start of a mission, choose an allied creature to be your partner. Both you and your partner gain +2 DR to all damage as well as +10 Defense when you are within sight of one another. 

Furthermore, your partner does not count towards Lone Ranger and doubles for Bandito.
Gain -10 D.M. to Accuracy and Critical Hit Chance as well as +10 Defense when less than 2 allied characters are within 6 tiles of you.
Your Pistolero bonus is improved, your secondary attack is now done with a -5 D.M. and may critically hit.

You may now dual wield standard pistols. As such this allows you to fire two shots in one attack action. Each attack roll is rolled separately. Your offhand pistol is rolled with an additional +10 D.M. to its accuracy and may not crit.

Note: This does not stack or work with Ambidexterous.
Once per mission you can reload your pistols or magnum as a quick action.

You no longer have any penalties for using a Magnum one handed. Your magnums also gain an additional +2 to critical damage and penetration. 

Note: This does not stack with multiple equipped Magnums.

Mark an enemy within your visual range and call them out for a duel. Until the end of your next turn they are considered Taunted by you and will only make hostile actions against you. Further more, any attacks you make with a pistol against them gain a -5 D.M. to hit and an additional -5 D.M. to critical chance.
You gain -10 D.M. Critical Hit bonus against creatures who are exposed to you and an additional -10 D.M. Critical Hit bonus against creatures who have not taken their first turn in combat.
Gain a -5 D.M. to your accuracy per degree of elevation you have against an enemy. All enemies will gain an addtional +5 D.M. per degree of elevation you have on them

Make a special attack against a foe that you can see. This attack gains a +15 D.M. and does full damage. Legs: Reduce their movement speed by 4 tiles
Torso: They gain Bleeding (2) and Vulnerable(2)
Arm: Target gains a +25 D.M. on their next turns attacks. (Grenades, guns, melee)

Disabling Shot: When you make this attack and succeed the target now also gains Disoriented (1). The energy cost of this ability is reduced by 1.

Hit and Run: After using this ability you gain a bonus -10 D.M. to your next saving throw before the end of your next turn. The energy cost of this ability is reduced by 1.

Called Shot: Once you've made your Called Shot attack, regardless of if you hit or not, your next turns movement is increased by 3 tiles. The energy cost of this ability is reduced by 1.
Gain the uncanny ability to detect potential undercover threats among the crowds.

Make a shot with a +15 D.M. if you land the hit, the targeted creature is then forced to reload their equipped weapon to use it again if applicable. This attack deals half damage to the creature as well.

Disabling Shot: Increase the accuracy bonus by -10 D.M. to Disabling Shot for a total of +5 D.M. on the attack. If you hit the creature also drops their weapon.

Hit and Run: On the next attack you make after using this ability it gains a -10 D.M. boost to its critical hit chance.

Called Shot: Increase the accuracy bonus by -10 D.M. to Called Shot for a total of +5 D.M. on the attack. Their save is now increased to a +15 DM as well.
Force an enemy to run to new cover. This attack gains a -30 bonus to hit, but deals 50% less damage, cannot crit, and consumes two additional ammo. Hunkered units cannot be forced to move.

Disabling Shot: You can now use this ability as a reaction shot against a target you can see who is attack an allied creature. You will resolve this attack as if it was a normal use of this ability and your attack goes before the enemies. If you hit it interrupts their shot and prevents their attack.

Hit and Run: Choose an ally you can see, when you use this ability both them and you gain a temporary boost to your defense by +5 until the end of your next turn.

Called Shot: When you hit a foe with this ability, the closest allied creature that is missing HP will regain an amount equal to your weapons Critical Damage amount.

Disabling Shot: If you use this ability on and enemy that takes their turn after you in the combat order, this attack may now critically hit and does full damage.

Hit and Run: When you use this ability, you may make a standard attack on a new enemy within your Line of Sight as part of this ability. All standard modifiers will apply on this attack roll.

Called Shot: If you use this ability on and enemy that takes their turn after you in the combat order, add a -10 D.M. to your shot. Also increase their saving throw by +10 D.M.
After attacking an enemy you are flanking you may move half your speed.

You gain one free re-roll of any missed attack that is tied to your Primary Role Ability if it is Disabling Shot or Called Shot. (Per Mission)

Hit and Run: Upon using Hit and Run your next attack will gain a -25 D.M. to its accuracy and Critical Chance

Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 Pistols and Magnums. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium and Long range by -5.

Disabling Shot: So long as you have moved in this turn, your disabling shot attack can be done with a -15 D.M. to its Accuracy. Its energy cost is also reduced by 1.

Hit and Run: You may now move your full movement with this ability. Its energy cost is also reduced by 1.

Called Shot: So long as you have moved in the same turn, the saving throw is increased by +15 D.M. Its effects are also updated to the following -

Legs: Reduce their movement speed by 6 tiles

Arm: Target gains a +35 D.M. on their next turns attacks. (Grenades, guns, melee)

Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 Precision Weapons. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short, Medium and Long range by an additional -3.
You cannot roll lower than a 5 for your iniative.

You gain a -20 D.M. dodge bonus to reduce damage taken from explosives or traps. In addition you gain a point in the awareness skill. If awareness is maxed then add a point to any other physical skill.
Snipers no longer require 2 actions to fire. DMR's now are undodgable like their Sniper counterparts.

Take an aimed shot for your targets head. This shot is fired with a -10 D.M. to accuracy as well as a -10 D.M. to your critical chance. Upon hitting the target and scoring a critical hit if the remaining HP total is 10% or less on the target they die instantly.

When an enemy sniper makes a shot on an allied creature, so long as you realistically could have a shot lined up on the foe you can spend energy in order to take a reaction shot. This attack falls under standard overwatch rules, however, it bypasses any special perks that might allow the creature to dodge.
All of your shots gain an additional +3 penetration. Any time you land a Vital Shot double your weapons critical bonus.
When you land a shot on an enemy, you can add half of your Perception Modifier to the damage, this bonus damage is not reduced by DR.
You can now fire up to a number of times equal to how much ammo you currently have in your rifle for No Man's Land. (Different targets)

Setup into overwatch, you take a +5 D.M. to the attack instead of the standard D.M. for overwatch fire. These attacks can critical and you are able to take a total of two shots each on a different target.
This ability sets up a special overwatch shot that does not suffer from any of its standard penalties, furthermore, you may select what target triggers the attack.
Dictate a 2 tile square as your snipers nest. While you are in this nest you gain a -10 D.M. dodging and +2 to your critical hit damage.
The penalties from the Long Range for Sniper Rifles are reduced by half. You can also fire from Extreme Range.
If you did not move on your last turn gain -10 D.M. to Accuracy and Critical Hit chance as long as you hold your current position.

Take a specialized shot against a target you can see. This attack only requires one action point to be available. When making the attack you gain a +10 D.M. to the attack roll but a -30 D.M. for the critical chance hit.

All cover that you deploy has its width extended from 1 tile to 2 tiles in a straight line.

Deployable cover that you use is now considered full cover instead of half.
Enemy creatures no longer benefit from using your cover.
Cover that you deploy now has a special brace for people to mount their weapons upon. This braced mount increases their shot accuracy by -10 DM.
Your deployed cover is now considered one tier higher when considering flimsy, standard and durable.

Enhance your deployed cover with the Science divisions latest upgrades. When a creature takes cover behind it they gain +10 barrier. When this barrier is removed from the creature they are granted a -10 DM to all combat related checks on their next turn.
Your deployed cover now negates any elevation bonuses that an enemy would have against the creature using it.

With a set of tools and some can do attitude, you are capable of repairing and restoring destroyed cover. This repaired cover is considered standard half cover. Not turn ending but requires one action.
All healing items now have their range extended by 1 tile. This also works in tandem with Paramedic.
The cost of any healing consumable or health related gear is reduced by 25%.

When you heal an ally with any kind of medikit you dose them with some combat stims as well. These stims grant that creature an additional -15 DM to all checks until the end of their next turn. This effect stacks with others but cannot stack with itself.
When you treat an ally with any form of healing item they gain a -10 DM to their next check of resisting any means of mental assaults or breaks.
With the use of any kind of medikit, you immediately heal for half the rolled amount then additionally for that full rolled amount over the course of the next 4 rounds. Ends turn.

When you heal with any kind of medkit the target will gain a half the amount healed rounded down in DR against one damage type of your choice as well as physcial, ballistic, lasers and plasma, until the end of your next turn.
All buff effects done by perks within the Medic tree now gain an additional -5 DM boost.
Any ailment curing consumable now grants an additional -10 DM against the next save for the ailment it treats. This stacks with any other buffs the creature has.
Using a specialized gun you can now remotely fire a medkit dart to an ally. This dart has a range of 10 tiles and always hits.
Whenever you heal an ally with a medikit, you regain 2 HP yourself.
When you treat an ally with any form of healing item they gain -10 D.M. to the soldier’s next check to resist being afflicted with a physical debilitation.

With the Wind: After moving their full half movement the creature then gains +2 DR against all damage types until the end of your next turn.

Every medikit you carry gains two additional charges for free.
Any enemy that is hit by your Overwatch Reaction fire takes +20 D.M. to the dodge check to reduce damage. In addition you may spend 5 energy to grant a -20 D.M. to any reaction shot you take.

You make use of the various bits and pieces you've found while out n the field and create a specialized grenade. This takes 1 action to create. You may pick one of the grenades below to create.

Cold Grenade: Build a cold damage grenade.
Acid Grenade: Build a acid damage grenade.
Shock Grenade: Build a lightning damage grenade.

NOTE: These items expire at the end of the mission and cannot be sold or RTB.

Paramedic: Upon healing an ally, halve the healing done to them and grant a barrier equal to that amount on yourself and them. This does not stack multiple times.

Jury Rig: When you create one of the orginal three grenades, you can now combine two of them to deal a hybrid variant of damage. Furthermore, the energy cost is reduced by 1.

With the Wind: For each enemy that is passed by the runner within 3 tiles, they take 5 points of Physical damage that is otherwise not resisted by DR. This damage can only be done to an enemy once.

Paramedic: When you have rolled for the amount of healing done on your target, any allied creatures within 3 tiles will heal for half of that amount as well.

Jury Rig: You may now add your INT mod as additional damage to any deployable items crafted with this ability.

With the Wind: You no longer need to run up to an ally to use this, instead you may use this on any allies within a number of tiles equal to your INT modifer. Furthermore the energy cost is reduced by 1.
You no longer take the +15 D.M. penalty to reaction fire and your reaction fire can inflict Critical Hits.
Move to an ally within 1 action movement range and immediately use a medikit once. Not turn ending.

Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 Pistols. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by -5. Increase base crit damage by +1.

If the soldier only fires their weapon they may automatically enter Overwatch.

Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 Rifles. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Medium and Long range by -5. Crit damage is also increased by +1

Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 SMGs. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by -5. Crit damage is also increased by +1.

Jury Rig: When crafting an item with Jury Rig, you now create two of the same items.

With the Wind: Allies bolstered with this may now take a single attack action at the end of their movement as well.

Paramedic: You may now use this ability twice in one round. Each use of this still costs its full energy amount. If used a second time your turn ends.

Jury Rig: When crafting a makeshift grenade from the list it not longer costs an action to do. It still costs an action to use the grenade.

With the Wind: The ally may now move their full run movement speed with this ability.

Paramedic: You may now us Paramedic on yourself, moving to the nearest piece of cover in range. Not turn ending.

Jury Rigged: You may now craft any type of researched explosive (grenade, rockets, deployables).

With the Wind: Along with their movement the ally may now take one free action for any non aggressive interactions. This is limited to things that are not abilities or paraphysics as well. (Examples: Reload, Interact with objectives, people, go into Overwatch, etc.)
You pat an ally on the back and allow them to make half their movement immediately. This does not allow for any other actions on the allies behalf. Not turn ending for you.
The radius of all grenades is increased by 1.
You can re-roll the damage done by your grenades and take the higher amount furthermore deploying grenades is not turn ending when used with this ability. This is usable in tandem with Hail Mary.
Your grenades damage against all forms of cover is doubled.
After handling explosives and grenades for so long, you are now resistant against 1 point of shred.
You grenades are now more deadly, increase their shred by 1 and damage by 2.
All range of your grenades is increased by 2.
Double the range your grenades are capable of going. This lasts until the start of your next turn.
When a grenade lands within your shift movement range you can use energy to pick it up and throw it elsewhere before it detonates.
Any grenades that have a lingering effect see that effect last an extra round. (Smoke grenades, poison grenades, etc.)
Damaging grenades you use force the enemy to make a +20 D.M. toughness check or Bleed equal to the grenades Shred.
Grenades you use now critically hit for +4 damage. Flashbangs or other offensive support grenades impart +10 D.M. to the check enemies make to resist the effect.
When a grenade attack is botched, you may opt to either determine the direction or the force of the scatter. This must be declared before any of the scatter results are rolled.
When you are engaged in a duel, you add your PER or AGI mod (whichever is higher) as defense.
While engaged in a duel, you may add your PER or AGI mod (whichever is higher) as a bonus - DM to hit your target.
When you kill a foe that you are engaged in a duel with, you may automatically mark a new target to duel without energy cost within 6 tiles of you that you can see.
You gain an additional -10 DM to any dodge attempts you make against melee attacks.

Trick and bamboozle your foe with a flashy feint. Make a standard attack against them and force them to make a +15 DM PER save. If they fail they are considered Stunned(1) and if they pass they are considered Disorientated(1).
Make a special attack against an enemy they do not benefit from any defense value or DR from natural or worn armor.
Any attacks you make with a 1 handed melee weapon and the other hand is free you gain a bonus -15 DM to hit and an additional -15 D.M. to critical chance.
Increase your base critical chance by doubling your PER mod bonus to it.

Choose an enemy that you can see and challenge them to a duel. While you are in a duel against this foe they are unable to attack any other characters on the battlefield. This duel lasts until either the creature is killed or you are.
When engaged in a duel with an enemy, increase your weapons penetration by half your PER or AGI mod, whichever is higher.
Your melee strikes with 1 handed weapons are potent, do an additional +2 damage with them.
While you are engaged in a duel with a foe and are using a 1 handed melee weapon the other hand is free you may also add your CHA modifier in damage against that target.
On kill you may spend 5 energy to make another melee attack against an enemy within your reach.

Standing as a pinnacle of strength in battle, you may use your reaction to make a special dodge action. If you succeed in dodging you also gain DR to that damage type equal to half your STR mod rounded down.
If you are dual wielding, you can make your off hand attack with a +10 DM. This counts as Ambidextrous(2).

You let out a ferocious battlecry, all enemy creatures within 5 tiles of you that can hear you must make a +15 DM CHA save. If they fail they gain Panicked(2) as well as take Sonic damage equal to your CHA modifier.
All melee weapons gain an additional -5 DM to critical chance.
Gain -20 D.M. to any check to avoid debilitating effects. In addition you may spend 3 energy to reroll a single check that has benefitted from Indomitable.
Pick one known species of alien, you gain additional damage to that species equal to half your STR mod.
Whirlwind Strike is now capable of doing at least your full modifier damage against the additional foes hit.
Made from the Stuff of Legends, your Fearsome Battlecry now can inspire your allies. If they are under any form of mental debilitation they remake their save against it with a =10 DM.
If you are using a 2h weapon with Whirlwind Strike, force up to three creatures hit to make a +10 DM STR save. If they fail they are knocked prone.
If you are using two 1h weapons with Whirlwind strike, you may roll the weapon damage from your offhand and add it to the damage done on the main foe. This is not applied to other creatures.

Make a special attack with your melee weapon that hits all tiles directly around you. Pick a primary target to attack, if that attack hits you deal half of that amount of damage to all creatures within one tile of you.
As a reaction you can change the declared facing of your shield wall and shift to protect anyone behind you.
When taking the Shield Wall action reduce any damage taken by 1/4th and redirect any attack made against an ally within 1 tile of you to yourself.
You can purposely set off an explosive traps while shield wall is in use. When you do reduce the damage by 50% and allies take no damage if they are in range of the AoE.
When you activate shield wall, the closest ally to you gains HP equal to the highest amount of DR your shield has.
You now count as full cover when in Shield Wall. And can reduce damage by 1/3rd.

Select up to 3 allies you can see on the battlefield and Knight them. While they are knighted they gain defense equal to half your shields defense. They also do additional damage equal to half your TGH modifier. You are unable to grant yourself this buff, This lasts for 2 full rounds.
When you take the Shield Wall action you may spend five energy to allow one ally to move with you on your turn. This ally also gains your shields defense value.
While in your Shield Wall stance, you can use Shield Bash against an enemy and then immediately follow up with a main hand attack. If this attack hits the foe only benefits from half their DR.

Once per round when you successfully dodge an attack while equipped with a ballistic shield you may opt to take no damage instead of half. For a cost of energy you can apply this effect to an ally that is using your shield wall as cover.
When you deal shield bash damage, you heal for 3 HP automatically.
When you hit an enemy with your shield bash, force them to make a +10 DM TGH check. Upon failing they gain Stunned(2). If they succeed they gain Disorientated(1).
Shield bash now does 1d4+2 damage instead of 1d2.

When an enemy enters or leaves your melee range tiles you may spend a reaction to take a reaction attack against them with an actively equipped melee weapon. If no reaction is available you must use energy to use this.
Move to an enemy within Sprinting distance and immediately make a melee attack.

When you attack an enemy you can make a special followup attack. If the first attack hit your enemy the follow up strike is done on the same enemy with a -10 DM to hit and to crit chance. If your first attack missed this attack is done with no bonuses.

Bladestorm: If you manage to kill an enemy when using this ability, gain 1/2 the damage done from killing them as either Ablative Armor -or- Barrier your choice.

Charge: If you kill an enemy with this ability, they are unable to benefit from any perks or abilities that would otherwise save them from death.

Cross Strike: When you crit with the first attack of this ability, do an additional 50% (rounded up) crit damage also the second strike gains a -25 DM to crit, it does not gain any additional damage.

Bladestorm: You may now trigger this ability against any enemy that moves within 2 tiles of you with a one handed weapon and 3 tiles with a two handed weapon, not just melee range. The attack is made as if they were in melee range.

Charge: This ability now grants a barrier equal to half the amount of tiles you moved. Additionally the attack made at the end of your charge cannot be dodged or parried, only reduced by DR. The cost of this ability is reduced by 1.

Cross Strike: When you hit the target with the second strike, they must make a +20 DM TGH check or become Disorientated(2) and Vulnerable(5).
Gain -10 D.M. to dodge checks against any attacks made against you by targets within 4 tiles. Enemies within 4 tiles of you take +15 D.M. to critical hit tests against you.

Bladestorm: Any enemy struck by this ability has their movement reduced by 2 and takes a -10 DM penalty to dodge until the end of their next turn. These effects stack per hit up to 3 times.

Charge: The damage from your charge can no longer be reduced by armor or ablative HP. If an organic target would otherwise survive the charge, this can reduce them to 25% HP automatically. This effect can only be used once per mission.

Cross Strike: Any damage dealt by either strike of this ability cannot be healed until the end of your next turn. If both attacks hit, any regeneration on the target is immediately removed.
Upon killing an enemy with your weapon you gain 1 ablative hit point. Stacks up to your Toughness modifier.
Your melee attacks impose a +5 DM penalty to the target's dodge attempts until the start of your next turn
When you attempt to dodge (parry) an enemies melee attack you gain a -10 DM to the check. This stacks with Flow of Battle.

While you are engaged in melee the D.M. for shooting you is increased by +10. Enemies normally immune to the Engaged in Melee circumstance still take the penalty when firing at you, but not take the additional +10 D.M.

Bladestorm:  Each successive bladestorm attack you make in a single round against different enemies deals 20% more damage than the last, stacking without limit until the start of your next turn. This extra damage only applies to Bladestorm.

Charge: Your charge now passes through any enemies in its path, hitting each one for 5 damage before striking your primary target. Enemies struck this way are knocked prone upon failing a +10 DM STR check.

Cross Strike: If both attacks hit, the enemy automatically gains Stunned(2).
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 3 One Handed Weapons. Furthermore increase the hone of these weapons by -5 and their base damage by 1.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 One Handed Weapons. Furthermore increase the hone of these weapons by -5 and their base damage by 2.

Make a powerful attack against your selected foe, this attack gains a +15 DM to hit, however it does an additional 50% damage to the enemy. This attack can critically hit as well. This only work with your main hand attack.
Any time you use a melee weapons special ability, if it requires a save against any effect increase the save for the enemy by +5 DM.
Shields now gain an additional +1 DR. They also gain +3 defense as well as +2 Ablative HP.
Shields are now resilient against 1 Shred reducing it to a minimum of 0. They also gain an additional +2 Defense as well as +3 Ablative HP.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 3 Two Handed Weapons. Furthermore increase the hone of these weapons by -5 and their base damage by 1.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 Two Handed Weapons. Furthermore increase the hone of these weapons by -5 and their base damage by 2.
Increase your HP by 5 points and your Energy by 3 points.
Increase your HP by 5 points.
Increase your HP by 5 points.
Increase your Energy by 5 points.

Bladestorm: Any attack made with this ability now benefits from a -10 DM against the target. Furthermore the cost of this ability is reduced by 1.

Charge: When you charge, you now gain defense equal to the number of tiles you moved up to +10.

Cross Strike: This ability can now be used against a second target if applicable.

Bladestorm: This ability is now usable when an enemy attempts to attack you while in melee.

Charge: You now add 1/4th the distance you charged as additional damage on the target you select, this damage is dealt regardless of if your attack hits or misses. 

Cross Strike: Both of your attacks now gain an additional -5 DM to both accuracy and critical chance.
Allow any ally that have you in their line of sight to add your CHA+TGH mod as an bonus negative modifier to any save against mind effecting abilities.
Increase the DR of all damage by 1/2/3 depending on the tier of armor you are wearing.
Anytime you hit an enemy with an attack using your primary weapon, they must make a Charisma Save with a +10 D.M. Upon failing it they are considered Taunted by you until the end of their turn.
Expend energy to regain a number of HP equal to 2x your Toughness Modifier. Allies that can see you feel inspired and regain half this amount in HP.
Re-roll any failed toughness or strength saves. Up to two times per mission.
In a radius of 4 tiles around you bolster your allies by granting them all temporary DR for all damage equal to half your toughness modifier. This lasts for 2 rounds.
When caught in melee spend energy to make a standard attack with no melee or cumbersome penalty on that attack. After it hits you may disengage and that disengage is not turn ending.
All shredding done to you is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 1.
Reduce all physically damaging DoT time effects by 1 turn. (Ignited, Acidized, Frostbite, etc)
Anytime you get a kill on an enemy, increase your current ablative armor by 3 not to exceed your armors total.
Gain an additional -15 D.M. to resist all mind altering effects.
You now count as half-cover for anyone that stands behind you.
Your turrets now do an additional dice size + 2 worth of damage.
You are now capable of fielding two specialized turrets to the field. (WIZ-360/GAU-5)
Any turret deployed by you is now considered a difficult check in order to be hacked.
Deploy a GAU-5 turret. This machine is superior variation of the standard deployable turret. It hit harder, lasts longer and can defend a wider area against foes.
Your turrets are reinforced with armor plating. They now gain +5 DR from Ballistic and Physical damage. As well as +3 DR from all other sources.
The ammo capacity of your deployable turrets is now doubled.
Your turrets now deploy with a barrier amount equal to your INT mod x 4. The battery of turret also lasts for an additional 10 rounds.
Now when you deploy an auto turret onto the battlefield it only costs a single action to do.
oubles the HP of a turret. Its battery also lasts and additional 3 rounds.
This ability can be used from 10 tiles away and will allow your turret to repair itself for 25% of its total HP. This ability does not bring a destroyed turret back to operational status.
When a turret fires upon a target, it no longer receives the Overwatch debuff.
Deploy the WIZ-360 turret. This machine no longer attacks enemy targets, but rather defends a location by swatting down enemy rockets, grenades and bombs. It can defend from all directions as well.
Lay down suppressing fire in a zone with a radius of 3 tiles. Costs 5 ammo. Turn Ending.

Whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 HP with any of your primary role abilities, you and all allies within 6 tiles gain +3 Defense and restore energy equal to half your Perception modifier. This effect can trigger once per turn. The defense bonus fades at the start of your next turn.

While moving up half of your movement, lay into a single target with saturating fire. Gain a +10 DM to the attack. If it hits you also apply Vulnerable (3) on the target. Costs 3 ammo. Turn Ending.

Efficient Fire: 5 Energy cost and 2 ammo cost now.
Reduce the total ammo cost of your chosen Primary Role ability by 1. Furthermore reduce the energy cost for this ability by 1 as well.
You gain an addition +10 to your Maximum Capacity
Force an enemy to run to new cover. This attack gains a -30 D.M. to hit, but deals 50% less damage, cannot crit, and consumes three total ammo. Hunkered units cannot be forced to move.

Area Suppression: Allies within your suppression zone gain +5 Defense and a -5 DM to their dodge checks against attacks made by suppressed enemies. This bonus lasts as long as the zone is active.

Walk'em Down: When you successfully hit and apply Vulnerable to a target, the first ally that attacks that target before the start of your next turn gains a -10 DM to their attack roll against them.

Sweeping Fire: Allies within 3 tiles of any enemy struck by your sweep may immediately shift 1 tile in any direction as a free action, allowing them to reposition without spending movement.

Area Suppression: Your zone of suppression is increased by an additional tile. The ammo cost is further reduced by one. Additionally all creatures are Shredded by 1 point.

Walk'em Down: Now gains a -10 D.M. to the attack. This attack also applies Vulnerable (10) and Shreds 2 DR. Lastly you make take your full movement when using this ability.

Sweeping Fire: Extends the range of your Sweeping Fire by one more. Also gain an additional -10 D.M. on your attacks against any hostile creature within the zone of attack.

Area Suppression: Designate up to three creatures within your zone of suppression, you gain an automatic attack roll to hit them upon placing the zone. These attacks are resolved as normal attacks. The damage is halved.

Walk'em Down: You make now designate an additional creature within 2 tiles of your primary target to hit with this ability. This costs no additional ammo, and resolves as if it would if it was just the base ability.

Sweeping Fire: Any creature hit by your sweeping fire takes and additional 4 damage, this additional damage is not reduced by armor.
Heavy armor now gains an additonal 50% Ablative armor rounded up that is calculated off the base value of the worn armor.
The total capacity cost of heavy armor is reduced by 50%. All heavy armor worn also gains +1 DR against all damage types.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 3 LMGs. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Medium and Long range by -3. Increase their crit damage by +1.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 LMGs. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Medium and Long range by and additional -3.

Area Suppression: If a suppressed enemy triggers Reaction Fire from the Suppressing soldier, that attack gains a -20 D.M. bonus.

Walk'em Down: When you hit a foe you will additionally reduce their movement by a number equal to your Perception modifier for their next turn if they fail a Toughness check at a +15 DM. They will slow for half that amount rounded down on a save.

Sweeping Fire: All targets struck by sweeping fire will have their movement reduced by 2 tiles.

Walk'em Down: When using Walk'em Down you now have a flat +0 DM to the attack. Furthermore upon hitting the enemy you will apply Vulnerable (6) onto them.

Area Suppression: The effect of Area Suppression is increased to a 4 tile radius. Energy cost of Area Suppression is reduced by 1.

Sweeping Barrage: When you strike a target with your Sweeping Fire you now will do half the total damage to all other creatures in the AoE or the weapons flat damage modifier, whichever is higher. Further more the AoE cone is increased by 1.

name: Put the Fear in the Them!

system.description:
Area Suppression: When an enemy is suppressed by you they must make a +30 D.M. Charisma check. If they fail they will panic and be forced to take the Hunker Down action on their turn.

Walk'em Down: Force the targeted enemy regardless of if you hit them or not with the attack to make a +10 D.M. Charisma check. If they fail they are considered under the Stunned (2) effect.

Sweeping Barrage: In a flashy sweeping style, all targets within the AoE must make a +30 D.M. toughness check. Upon failing they become Disorientated as well as Vulnerable (2).
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 3 SAWs. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by -3. Increase their crit damage by +1.
Firstly gain the appropriate training to use up to Tier 5 SAWs. Furthermore increase the Rangefinder bonuses for Short and Medium range by and additional -5.
Your LMGs and SAWs now shred armor when they hit the enemy. This is 1/2/3 depending on the tech level of your weapon.
Increase your STR and TGH attribute by +5. Also gain one rank in Athletics or any physical skill if you have already maxed out your Athletics skill.

Fire in a sweeping cone of 4 tiles. Making an attack roll on the primary called target. On a successful hit do standard damage against that target, on all other creatures in the cone do the weapons flat additional damage regardless of if the primary target was hit. This additional damage bypasses DR Costs 4 ammo. Turn Ending.
Increase your HP by 5 points and your Energy by 3 points.
Increase your HP by 5 points.
Increase your HP by 5 points.
Increase your Energy by 5 points.
When you are in cover and not exposed, automatically reduce damage from attacks made through that cover by 1. In addition you gain -10 D.M. to dodge checks against attacks on you made through cover.
Your rockets always impose 2 extra failures (total of three) to cover and structures.
When an allied creature is caught in the blast radius of a rocket, they can make a -10 D.M. Agility save to take no Shred and halve the damage.
Firing your RPG is no longer turn ending at the cost of energy.
If your rocket scatters from your target destination you reduce the distance scattered by two tiles, to a minimum of one. Stacks with Reinforced Launcher.
All of your rockets gain an additional +2 Shred.
Your rockets now gain double the bonus from any targeting on a creature.
Your rocket launcher’s range increases by 8 tiles.
Rockets can now benefit from targeting. You also gain an additional -10 D.M. to all shots from your RPG.
Rockets can now critically hit. Their critical damage bonus is +2. Furthermore creatures caught in a critical blast must make a +20 D.M toughness check or become Disorientated (1).
Increase the radius of your rocket by 2. The damage is also increased by 50%. Can be used with Drop the Sky.
If your rocket scatters from your target destination you reduce the distance scattered by one tile to a minimum of one.
When firing a rocket, you add an additional amount of damage equal to half your perception mod.
